name: Go
custom_script: sudo rm -rf /usr/local/go && curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.25.6.linux-amd64.tar.gz | sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf - && (grep -qxF 'export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH' ~/.profile 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.profile) && . ~/.profile && go version

name: Node.js
custom_script: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh | bash && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install --lts && nvm alias default 'lts/*' && node -v && npm -v

name: OpenJDK
custom_script: mkdir -p ~/.local/opt/jdk && curl -fL "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/21/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse?project=jdk" -o /tmp/jdk.tgz && rm -rf ~/.local/opt/jdk/cur && mkdir -p ~/.local/opt/jdk/cur && tar -xzf /tmp/jdk.tgz -C ~/.local/opt/jdk/cur --strip-components=1 && ln -sf ~/.local/opt/jdk/cur/bin/java ~/.local/bin/java && ln -sf ~/.local/opt/jdk/cur/bin/javac ~/.local/bin/javac && java -version

name: PHP
custom_script: curl -fL https://github.com/phpbrew/phpbrew/releases/latest/download/phpbrew.phar -o ~/.local/bin/phpbrew && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/phpbrew && phpbrew init && grep -qxF '[[ -e ~/.phpbrew/bashrc ]] && source ~/.phpbrew/bashrc' ~/.bashrc || echo '[[ -e ~/.phpbrew/bashrc ]] && source ~/.phpbrew/bashrc' >> ~/.bashrc && . ~/.phpbrew/bashrc && phpbrew known

name: Python 3
custom_script: curl -fsSL https://pyenv.run | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.pyenv/bin:$PATH" && eval "$(pyenv init -)" && pyenv versions

name: Ruby
custom_script: curl -fsSL https://github.com/rbenv/rbenv-installer/raw/HEAD/bin/rbenv-installer | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.rbenv/bin:$PATH" && eval "$(rbenv init - bash)" && rbenv -v

name: yarn
custom_script: corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@stable --activate && yarn -v

name: DBeaver
custom_script: curl -fL https://dbeaver.io/files/dbeaver-ce-latest-linux.gtk.x86_64.tar.gz -o /tmp/dbeaver.tgz && rm -rf ~/.local/opt/dbeaver && mkdir -p ~/.local/opt/dbeaver && tar -xzf /tmp/dbeaver.tgz -C ~/.local/opt/dbeaver --strip-components=1 && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "$HOME/.local/opt/dbeaver/dbeaver" "$@"\n' > ~/.local/bin/dbeaver && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/dbeaver

name: Docker
custom_script: curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com/rootless | sh && export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH" && systemctl --user start docker && docker version
